sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Access secure services, view your details and lodge online.

Deductions for medical assessments, vaccinations, COVID-19 tests, gym fees, cosmetics and personal grooming.

Deductions you can and can't claim for medical expenses, dental expenses, vaccinations and COVID-19 test expenses.

As a rule, you can't claim the costs of personal grooming or cosmetics.

Except in very limited circumstances, you can't claim gym fees or fitness-related expenses.
